from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Input validation
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
        (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
        (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
    ]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")

    if not (
        logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape
    ):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")

    # Compute weights: decreasing linearly to 0 at t=5 (max(0, 1-0.2*t))
    horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Normalization denominator zero (all weights zero)")
    weights = raw_weights / weight_sum  # shape (horizon,)

    # Weighted sums of log probabilities (each shape (n_candidates,))
    w_sum_result = np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)
    w_sum_call = np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    w_sum_no = np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)

    # Losses = -weighted_sum_of_log_probs
    L_result = -w_sum_result
    L_call = -w_sum_call
    L_no = -w_sum_no

    # Margin: reduction in loss from no_call to with_result
    margin = L_no - L_result

    # Keep if API call helps (L_result < L_no and L_result < L_call)
    # and margin exceeds threshold
    keep = (L_result < L_no) & (L_result < L_call) & (margin > tau_filter)

    return (keep, margin)
